Refit fastlmm model with new delta

Source: R/refitModel.R
refitModel.Rd

Refit fastlmm model with new delta value

Usage

refitModel(fit, delta)

Arguments

fit

model fit of class fastlmm

delta

new value for delta

Details

Useful for evaluating log-likelihood and multiple values of delta

Examples

library(lme4)

fit <- fastlmm(Reaction ~ Days + (1 | Subject), sleepstudy)

summary(fit)
#> Linear mixed model fit by ML ['fastlmm']
#> 
#> Coefficients:
#>             Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
#> (Intercept) 251.4051     9.5062   26.45   <2e-16 ***
#> Days         10.4673     0.8017   13.06   <2e-16 ***
#> ---
#> Signif. codes:  0 ‘***’ 0.001 ‘**’ 0.01 ‘*’ 0.05 ‘.’ 0.1 ‘ ’ 1
#> 
#> Variance components:
#>   sigSq_g: 1297
#>   sigSq_e: 954.5
#>   hSq:     57.6 %
#> 

summary(refitModel(fit, delta=1000))
#> Linear mixed model fit by ML ['fastlmm']
#> 
#> Coefficients:
#>             Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
#> (Intercept)  251.405      6.563  38.308  < 2e-16 ***
#> Days          10.467      1.228   8.527 6.31e-15 ***
#> ---
#> Signif. codes:  0 ‘***’ 0.001 ‘**’ 0.01 ‘*’ 0.05 ‘.’ 0.1 ‘ ’ 1
#> 
#> Variance components:
#>   sigSq_g: 2.238
#>   sigSq_e: 2238
#>   hSq:     0.0999 %
#>
